goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester stayed in the Lobby. It walked to the Mission Board and tried the 'Pick a call' prompt three times (by path and with an E hold), then tried Squad Pad 2. Every interaction returned 'held, not triggered', so no round started and no fires, rescues or refills were attempted.

bugs.title: Mission Board 'Pick a call' prompt never triggers, so no round can start
bugs.evidence: Steps 3, 5 and 6: interact on Workspace.Map.Station.Lobby.MissionBoard returned 'held, not triggered' at about 10 studs and at 4.2 studs (prompt range 16). A 1s E hold at step 6 also failed. The playtesters report RoundState stays Lobby with no HUD change and no mission picker. The playtester never got past the lobby, so the goal was blocked.

bugs.title: Squad Pad 'Change call' prompt does not trigger
bugs.evidence: Step 8: interact on Workspace.Map.Station.Lobby.SquadPad2 ('Change call Pad 2') returned 'held, not triggered' while in range (about 6 studs). The attrs still show SquadId empty. The cause could be the same as the Mission Board failure, or the interact tool may not be completing the hold.
